name: Toshima (Kagoshima, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Toshima village emblem in black and red: a black outlined ring enclosing a red stylised volcano.
history: Municipal flag of Toshima, a village in Kagoshima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 9 December 1980.

features.role: Toshima village emblem — a black outlined ring enclosing a red stylised volcano
